description: Train/runtime contract for sign-recognition features. features.py (training) and features.ts (runtime) must implement this identically; a shared fixture test asserts max abs diff < 1e-6.

source_topology.note: Indices refer to legacy MediaPipe Holistic ordering used by the Kaggle GISLR data: face 468 pts, pose 33 pts, left hand 21 pts, right hand 21 pts. At runtime, slice face to [:468] before indexing (Tasks-API face mesh may emit 478).

normalization.translate: subtract midpoint of pose landmarks 11 and 12 (shoulders); fallback: pose landmark 0 (nose) if both shoulders missing
normalization.scale: divide by euclidean distance between pose landmarks 11 and 12; fallback: 1.0 if missing
normalization.missing: NaN or undetected landmarks become 0.0 AFTER normalization

mirror_augmentation.note: Horizontal mirror must swap left/right hand blocks and pose L/R pairs (11<->12, 13<->14, 15<->16, 23<->24) and negate x after centering.
